notes.title: New enemies and weapon
notes.content:
- 3 new enemies - fast moving robotic buggies.

- New weapon - an underbarrel stunner - a projectile that causes a chain ligthing that slows down mechs and drones.

- Minor graphical changes - updated muzzle flashes, added projectile burn marks, etc.

- Balance tweaks
